card.name: Plural endings like -ives, -ules, -umes
card.fires_on: The ending of a plural noun split across pieces, such as Ch|ives, gran|ules, f|umes, eyeg|lasses. Also the word "of" after "odds".

modes.label: Plural noun endings
modes.description: The final piece of a plural noun that was split into parts, often ending in -s.
modes.example: Hold the catheter-tipped syringe with the tip up and check for any gran<<ules>> remaining in the tip.

modes.label: Odds of
modes.description: The word "of" right after "odds" when talking about chances.
modes.example: Your odds<< of>> getting smacked by a meteorite

card.writes: It favors plural endings such as -ies, -ces and -ths, and Chinese plural markers, while disfavoring unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It lights up on the last part of a split-up plural noun, like granules or chives, and on "of" after "odds".
